name: logbook
description: Capture, ingest, query and lint a Logbook vault (OKF v0.2): one immutable note per invocation, synthesized into cross-linked wiki pages — plus guide, runbook, document and walkthrough, which author detailed documentation from verified sources, task, a per-repo board of pending work anchored against the real code, template, which designs a reusable note shape from the vault's conventions and web research, and run, which executes the job a note describes and records the outcome back in it.
